bearish_candlestick.name: Evening Star
bearish_candlestick.description: An Evening Star is a candlestick pattern trend reversal indicator. It is a bearish candlestick pattern consisting of three candles: a large white candlestick, a small-bodied candle, and a red candle.

oscillator_parameter.name: Stochastic Oscillator
oscillator_parameter.description: Stochastic %K compares the lowest low and the highest high of a given period to define a price range, then displays the last closing price as a percentage of this range. A possible sell signal is generated if the white %K line crosses below the red %D line.

oscillator_parameter.name: Awesome Oscillator
oscillator_parameter.description: The Awesome Oscillator is a non-limiting oscillator, providing insight into a stock's weakness or strength. The Awesome Oscillator is used to measure market momentum and to affirm trends or anticipate possible reversals. It effectively compares the recent market momentum with the general momentum over a wider frame of reference.

oscillator_parameter.name: Stochastic RSI
oscillator_parameter.description: Stochastic RSI is derived by applying stochastic oscillator formula to a set of relative strength index (RSI) values. Stochastic RSI %K compares the lowest low and the highest high of RSI values for a given period to define a price range.

oscillator_parameter.name: Ultimate Oscillator
oscillator_parameter.description: The Ultimate Oscillator is a range-bound indicator with a value that fluctuates between 0 and 100. Levels below 30 represent oversold conditions, and levels above 70 represent overbought conditions.

adx_DMP_14.name: ADX Positive DM
adx_DMP_14.description: The ADX DMP (Directional Movement Positive) indicator is a trend indicator in the positive direction. The ADX helps investors determine trend strength, while positive DM indicates strength. This is measured over 14 bars.

adx_DMN_14.name: ADX Negative DM
adx_DMN_14.description: The ADX DMN (Directional Movement Negative) indicator is a trend indicator in the negative direction. The ADX helps investors determine trend strength, while negative DM value indicates weakness. This is measured over 14 bars.
